references.text: Joshua gathers all Israel together with their elders, leaders, judges and officials, in the same way as here
Moses also gathered the elders of Israel and their officials to speak to them before his death
Abraham was old and advanced in years, the same expression is used for Joshua's age
Abraham was old and well along in years, parallel to Joshua's description of his own age
King David was also old and well along in years, using the same Hebrew expression for old age
Earlier in the book of Joshua it is mentioned that Joshua had become old and advanced in years
The Lord commanded Moses to gather the elders of Israel, a pattern that Joshua follows here
Moses gathered all the Israelites including leaders, tribes, elders and officials
